contract: Wrap content in TenKBorderBeam. Original2.5second linear revolution,140to270degree angular window,0.6dp stroke,0.5dp inset,diagonal beam colors,inverse blurred interior and beamBlur/1.5mask are adapted with native Android Canvas shaders. Empty beam colors keep only the border; enabled=false removes the effect but retains content. Reduced motion displays a static phase; animation pauses when lifecycle stops. Software layer provides blur on API28; exact Swift blur compositing/tertiary opacity/adaptive colors and physical frame performance remain unverified. Original icon-only controls/precise gallery UI are not fully reproduced.
